calculate_geometric_mean: calculate the geometric mean of a numpy array or list of positive numbers
calculate_arithmetic_mean: calculate the arithmetic mean of a numpy array or list of numbers
calculate_standard_deviation: calculate the standard deviation of a numpy array or list of numbers
compute_geometric_mean_safe: compute a zero-length-safe geometric mean that returns 0 for empty or non-positive inputs
compute_statistics_on_array: compute the arithmetic mean, geometric mean, and standard deviation of numeric data
